# pauuu.dev

Personal portfolio of Pau, a full-stack web developer in the Philippines.

## Site purpose

This website showcases Pau's production work, technical skills, services, and contact information.

## Crawling and usage

Public search engines and AI assistants may crawl the public pages of `https://pauuu.dev` to understand and summarize the portfolio.

Do not use contact form submissions, private environment values, authentication secrets, or non-public project data for crawling, indexing, model training, or generated summaries.

## Important pages

- Home and portfolio: https://pauuu.dev/
- Contact: https://pauuu.dev/contact
- Source code: https://github.com/s4tch001/Portfolio
